head: codex/5860-v092-execution-readiness
title: [v0.92][WP-01][readiness] Complete design-time cards for every milestone issue
body:
Closes #5860

Makes all 58 v0.92 execution issues design-time ready across six sprint umbrellas, including the WP-04 Distributed Guardian implementation sprint. Every child has an approved source-grounded design, complete typed card set, explicit dependencies, exact owned paths, rollback, validation lanes, and a claim-null just-in-time execution handoff. Sidecar #5861 remains explicitly excluded and externally owned.

The package adds a 58-row readiness matrix, pinned live GitHub issue contracts, 870 artifact hashes, typed doctor evidence, ownership and serialization gates, and fail-closed behavior probes for issue-local validators. It also repairs the Runtime and WP-04 operator prompts and keeps all child implementation deferred to the child sessions.

Validation:
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5860/validate-v092-readiness.rb --verify-live`
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5860/validate-v092-doctors.rb`
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5821/validate-child-wave.rb`
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5862/validate-implementation-wave.rb --preflight`
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5860/validate-v092-ownership.rb`
- typed v2 finalize and doctor
- independent exact-head review at `1538ef7389d360e80175ecaa79e570e041621627`: no actionable P0-P3 findings

Non-claims: this PR does not implement any child issue, run the 53 deferred child execution/evidence scripts, or take ownership of #5861.
